title: A view model
description:
Write a view model that tells a user interface when its values change.

```
FirstName changed
FullName changed
CanSave changed
Saved: Ada Lovelace
```
hints: A `bool Set<T>(ref T field, T value, [CallerMemberName] string? name = null)` helper checks `EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals` and raises (lesson 6.04).
requirements: `class PersonViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged` with `FirstName`, `LastName`, a computed `FullName`, and `CanSave` (both names filled).
Setting a property raises `PropertyChanged` for it and for every property computed from it, only when the value really changes.
A simple `RelayCommand(Action execute, Func<bool> canExecute)`; `Save` runs only when `CanSave`.
stretch: Add validation through `INotifyDataErrorInfo` for names longer than 30 characters.
